description: Renovate refreshes only the pins that Dependabot cannot read: image references pinned by digest inside the launcher, and the mise tools used by CI.
Every update is a pull request for a person to review and merge. Renovate is configured never to merge.

customManagers.description: Image references written as name:tag@sha256:digest in the launcher.

packageRules.description: Allow a missing release timestamp only for these registries. Label their pull requests so a reviewer handles the cooldown when a timestamp is unavailable.
A mise tool update also needs new checksums in tools/ci/mise.lock and tools/ci/toolchain.py, which a person adds.
